current_gaze_state.name: Landscape with Mountains and Pavilion
current_gaze_state.description: A monochromatic ink painting depicting a misty mountain landscape with rocky outcrops, sparse vegetation, and a small pavilion nestled in the foreground. The composition uses layered brushwork and varying shades of gray to create depth and atmosphere, mounted on a plain wall with a small informational plaque nearby.
current_gaze_state.visual_signature: Misty mountains, ink wash technique, pavilion, sparse trees, horizontal format
